BENGALURU BENCH
Petitioner: Ramesh Kumar
Respondent: State of Karnataka
JUDGMENT
Date of Judgment: 15th March, 2024
This writ petition has been filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking a writ of certiorari to quash the order dated 10th January, 2024 passed by the Deputy Commissioner, Bengaluru Urban District.
Section 123 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872 provides that an agreement without consideration is void, unless it is expressed in writing and registered under the law for the time being in force.
Order VII Rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 empowers the court to reject a plaint where it does not disclose a cause of action.
Article 14 of the Constitution of India guarantees equality before the law and equal protection of the laws within the territory of India. The State shall not deny to any person equality before the law.
Having considered the submissions of both parties and the materials on record, this Court is of the opinion that the impugned order is liable to be quashed.
In the result, the writ petition is allowed. The impugned order dated 10th January, 2024 is hereby quashed.
Sd/-
Justice R. Venkatesh
Bengaluru
Dated: 15th March, 2024
